title: Design: A/P Summary title row and ⋯ button match the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show, as in the design picture.
  • Make sure the report lists vendors at both locations on today's date, one of them with documents at both.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "A/P gets the same menu" (ar-ap-p2-a-p-gets-the-same-menu.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the title row with the picture.
  2. Compare the filter row with the picture.
  3. Compare the column headings with the picture.
  4. Compare the vendor name cells and the Location cells with the picture.
  5. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title "A/P Aging Summary", the info icon right of it and the grey "⋯" at the far right.
  • No print icon.

Step 2:

  • "As of: " (blue pill), "Vendor: All vendors" (truck icon, resting), "Past due: Any" (hourglass icon, resting), "Location: All locations" (blue pill).

Step 3:

  • "Vendor" with a small up arrow, "Location", "Current", "1-30 Days", "31-60 Days", "61-90 Days", "91 And Over", "Total".

Step 4:

  • Vendor names are blue, A to Z.
  • A Location cell reads a location's name, or "Multiple" for a vendor with documents at both.
  • Total is bold.

Step 5:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • S5-R1: “Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.”
  • Out of Scope: “A/P print from a separate print button. A/P printing is delivered through the Export menu's PDF (SV-6163).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
